generation.promptRecordType: Public reconstruction of the design brief; not a verbatim generation-session transcript.

neutral: Asset type: transparent VTuber character anchor for the local-avatar-rig lightweight WebGL expression-state rig
Primary request: create a completely original young-adult virtual research navigator with a distinctive independent design

Subject: calm, intelligent, approachable feminine-presenting character; eyes fully open; tiny relaxed closed-mouth smile; perfectly symmetric relaxed head-and-torso pose; arms and hands entirely out of frame

Character design: medium-length layered moonlit silver-blue hair with clearly separated front bangs, left and right side locks, and back hair mass; warm amber-gold eyes; a single small four-point star hair ornament; no resemblance to any existing VTuber or real person
Outfit: structured deep-navy high-collar research jacket with restrained teal piping and small warm-gold accents; clean readable panels; modest coverage; no logo, no text, no brand marks
Style/medium: premium polished 2D anime character illustration, crisp production linework, refined cel shading, clean separated-looking forms suitable for a lightweight web rig

Composition/framing: exact 16:9 transparent canvas intended for 1672x941; perfectly straight-on camera; character precisely centered; complete hair silhouette, neck, upper torso, sleeves and both shoulders visible; generous transparent padding; eye centers near 37.5% canvas height; mouth center near 49% canvas height; no tilt; no three-quarter perspective
Rig affordances: unobstructed eyes and mouth; clean jaw/neck boundary; distinct hair masses and shoulder line; face proportions compatible with expression patch swapping

Constraints: genuinely transparent alpha background; one original character only; no background, no text, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no props, no hands, no cropped hair or shoulders, no duplicate body parts
Avoid: opaque or painted checkerboard background; dynamic pose; face occlusion; loose strands crossing eyes or mouth; extreme expression; photorealism; copied costume or facial design
